hana_l: Heads-up - Orion Health CIO wants an exec note. POC blocked: SSO metadata, KMS proof, and a firm month-1 spend cap.
mike_s: Got it. They want a written cap and a short confirmation we can spin a dedicated pool for 2 weeks. Who owns pricing approvals?
revops: We can approve a one-time credit but need revenue sign-off. Send expected $ cap and term.
raj_p: I can take SSO. Please drop their IdP metadata and Ill map claims. Tess, do we have a concise SSO template?
tess_k: Uploading SSO template to the drive. Note: we use email as primary identifier for most customers.
legal-bot: They also submitted an SQ asking about data residency and encryption-at-rest key ownership. Assigning to ops/legal.
ops-bot: Network checklist: TLS1.3 required, egress limited to us-east-1 for POC, customer-managed KMS supported.
mike_s: For pricing, propose a $Y hard cap month-1 as a conditional credit. I'll open a RevOps request now.
revops: Request received. Need confirmation that POC will be time-limited and no SLA changes promised.
hana_l: Agreed. Do not promise uptime beyond standard. We'll offer a time-boxed dedicated pool for evaluation only.
raj_p: ETA for SSO appendix: 12:30 PT. I'll include steps for Okta and generic IdP mapping.
tess_k: I'll prepare the combined packet (SSO appendix + network spec + SQ answers). Target upload by 15:00 PT.
ops-bot: Created SRE ticket #SRE-4602 for temporary pool review.
legal-bot: Legal ticket #LEGAL-802 opened for contract language on credit and POC terms.
mike_s: Thanks. Once packet is ready, I'll request exec review and then send to the customer. Keep updates short here.
